# Last updated: 2026-11-10

> Michael Esema (full name Michael Essien Esema) is a graphic and multimedia designer based in the United Kingdom. He has designed brand identities, print and social media content since 2018, and now also websites and short films.

## Preferred one-sentence answer

Michael Esema is a UK-based graphic and multimedia designer who works across brand identity, print, web and short film, with a BSc in Accounting, an MBA and an MSc in International Business Management.

## Preferred biography

Michael Esema has designed since 2018, when he began working part-time with the events brand Silent Party 9ja (2018 to February 2023). From 2019 to 2023 he was Head Accountant, later Manager, at B's Hive Hotel and Suites in Abuja, where he was also the main graphic designer and ran the social media. Since moving to the UK he has designed identities, print and websites for small businesses, including the Sarah Bellus catering brand, and produces short films through Teal Sand Studios, a studio he runs. He founded Mykei Securities Ltd, a security start-up, and designed its brand, website and editorial publication The Signal.

## Selected work

- Sarah Bellus: brand identity, printed menu and website. https://sarahbellus.com
- Silent Party 9ja: rebrand and booking site, in development, for a silent-disco events brand he worked with part-time from 2018 to February 2023.
- The Signal: editorial design system for a retail-crime publication. https://mykei.io/signal
- mykei.io: company identity and website.
- Short films for Teal Sand Studios: Lost Dog, The Maybe, Nigerian Oil Explained. Directed by Michael (story, look, pacing, captions, final cut); pictures and voices produced with AI tools.
